required_refinements: Keep separate ordered float32 training-cache keys and ordered float64 actual deployment-input keys, with semantic candidate identities separate. Candidate count and original candidate order are part of both numeric keys.

TaskNetwork.score converts original numeric inputs directly to float64; cache.decode converts to float32. Float32 equality describes cached training support only; it is not proof of indistinguishable deployed inputs.

Never cache actual model scoring or infer deployment aliasing using only float32 groups. Rescore original deployment-precision input, and only use complete float64 input equality for deployment-indistinguishability claims. If original precision is unavailable, report it unavailable rather than reconstructing float64 by upcasting float32.

Before full diagnostics, verify current fixed policy fresh-instance versus reused-instance equivalence on bounded old observations, with per-game/per-seat isolation. TaskAgent currently clears owned buffers and observe has no prior input; do not generalize this to future stateful policies.

Shadow policy is evaluated on the same sanitized observation but its own within-turn reservation path. Stop callback matching once input/candidate/planned-resource context differs; do not force ordinal alignment.
Current negative result is final. Diagnostic findings are exploratory, not reasons to change this panel, gates or model. An inconclusive completed diagnosis is acceptable.
